identity.title: Harden producer conformance for scope and provenance

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Upgrade the existing second-producer conformance proof so every producer must preserve explicit scope_ref and provenance, preserve unknown evidence, reject malformed canonical identity, and never promote missing authority/approval/budget evidence into clean governance state.
human_pressure.why_now: The external evidence ingress boundary is only real if a second producer can satisfy it without producer-specific branches.
do_not_misread: Do not add a producer registry.
Do not add EverRun-specific fixtures as the only proof.
Do not require producers to understand Ailuros internal projection implementation.
red_lines: Unknown preservation is a hard requirement.

machine_core.goal: Extend adapter/evidence-package conformance tests and fixtures to cover scope_ref, provenance, unknown preservation, malformed scope, and governance non-inference across at least the existing second-producer path.
red_lines: Do not weaken existing evidence-package validation.
Do not infer authorized/approved/clean state from producer outcome labels.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path.
invariants: Valid explicit scope_ref survives producer-neutral ingestion.
Unknown event types remain source-preserved unknown.
Malformed scope identity does not become trusted canonical scope.
Missing authority/approval/budget evidence never becomes evaluated clean state.

observable_effect.assertion: A non-EverRun producer proves the same scope/provenance and unknown-preservation contract without source-specific code.

proofs.assertion: Second-producer conformance tests cover valid scoped evidence plus malformed/unknown/non-inference cases.

failure_semantics: Malformed canonical scope fails validation or remains unavailable according to the existing contract; it is never normalized into a trusted value.
Unsupported events remain preserved rather than dropped or guessed.

steps.title: Extend valid second-producer proof
details: Add explicit scoped evidence and assert scope/provenance survive the canonical pipeline.

steps.title: Add malformed/unknown cases
details: Cover malformed scope, unsupported event type, and missing governance constraints.

steps.title: Prove non-inference
details: Assert producer-native success/accept labels do not create authorized, approved, or clean governance facts without evidence.

steps.title: Run full conformance suite
details: Ensure existing producer-neutral validation and all tests remain green.

acceptance: Second-producer scoped evidence passes without source-specific code.
Missing governance evidence is not promoted to clean/evaluated.

must_check: Unknown preservation and non-inference are explicit assertions.
No source-name branches are added to production code.
Malformed scope cannot become canonical identity.
reject_if: EverRun-specific behavior is added to satisfy the test.
Producer-native status is trusted as governance truth.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Existing second-producer and adapter conformance suites are the canonical place to prove the external ingress boundary.
